title: Lemon chicken orzo traybake
toddlerSplit: Lift out the toddlers' chicken and orzo before the feta and chilli flakes go on — feta is very salty for under-3s. Shred their chicken off the bone.
steps: Oven to 200C. Toss chicken, halved tomatoes, sliced courgette and crushed garlic in oil, salt and oregano on a deep tray.
Stir in the orzo and hot stock, squeeze over one lemon. Back in for 12 minutes.
Take out the toddlers' portions now, plain.
Crumble feta and chilli flakes over the rest, squeeze the second lemon, rest 2 minutes and serve.
